definitions.explanation: The total amount of money paid to someone per year as compensation for their work.

examples.english: The annual salary is 5 million yen.

examples.japanese: {年俸|ねんぽう}{制|せい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: I work under an annual salary system.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{年俸|ねんぽう}1{億|おく}⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大型|おおがた}→大型：03016_oogata⟧⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{結|むす}んだ→結ぶ：02308_musubu⟧。
examples.english: That player signed a major contract with an annual salary of 100 million yen.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧ (year) and {俸|ぽう} (stipend, salary). The kanji {俸|ぽう} specifically refers to official remuneration.

USAGE:
Commonly appears in sports news (especially baseball and soccer contract negotiations) and business/employment contexts. {年俸|ねんぽう}{制|せい} is a pay system where salary is set as an annual lump sum rather than monthly, common for executives and professional athletes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {年俸|ねんぽう}{制|せい} — annual salary system
- {年俸|ねんぽう}⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧ — salary negotiation
- ⟦{推定|すいてい}→推定：04293_suitei⟧{年俸|ねんぽう} — estimated annual salary
- {年俸|ねんぽう}⟦アップ→アップ：00005_appu⟧ — salary increase

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{年収|ねんしゅう}→年収：05504_nenshuu⟧ — annual income; total yearly earnings including all sources
- ⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧ — salary, pay; the general everyday term
- ⟦{月給|げっきゅう}→月給：04692_gekkyuu⟧ — monthly salary; pay calculated per month
